title: GridView Grand Prix event registry (curated stable identity)
description: The curated registry that owns every eventSlug. A curator creates each slug in a reviewed repository change, exactly as for a driver, constructor or circuit; no provider adapter derives, normalizes or mints one. An accepted eventSlug is immutable: it is never renamed, repointed at another event or reused. A slug is season-independent - the same event recurs every season - so the season qualifier lives in GrandPrix.id ({season}-{eventSlug}), which is built elsewhere and never here. See docs/adr/0022-curated-provider-identifier-mappings.md amendment A1.

registryEvent.description: One canonical event identity. It carries no provider value, no provider response object, no round, no date and no circuit: those are season-scoped or provider-scoped facts that belong to a season's calendar or to a mapping record, not to the identity itself.

name.description: Human-readable name for the reviewer. Never an identity, and never used for matching.
